app.title: The Last Apiary
app.tagline: A cozy idle colony on Solana.

wallet.title: Pledge to the Queen
wallet.description: Sign in once with Seed Vault. Your colony state is tied to your wallet.

home.step_connect_desc: Sign in once with Seed Vault. Your colony state is tied to your wallet.
home.step_build_desc: Place hives on a 3×3 grid. They produce honey, energy, food and water — even when the app is closed.
home.step_claim_desc: Resources accumulate up to 48 hours. Claim every 8 hours and unlock unique cNFT skins as you upgrade buildings.
home.next_action_first_hive: Place your first Bee Hive — tap any empty cell.
home.next_action_solar: Add a Solar Panel — your hives need power.
home.next_action_food: Add a Small Farm — your bees are hungry.
home.next_action_water: Add a Water Collector — supply is running low.
home.next_action_claim: Your honey is ready — claim it.
home.next_action_storage_full: Storage is almost full — claim or upgrade Storage.
home.next_action_idle: Wait for the next cycle, or build more.
home.intro_story_body: The world's pollinators are vanishing. A surviving queen has chosen you to rebuild her colony, hex by hex. Soon other queens will hear of your apiary and come to compete on the Royal Leaderboard.

colony.title: Hive
colony.empty_hint_title: 🐝 Tap any tile to build your first hive
colony.empty_hint_body: Hives produce honey passively. Add Solar to power them, then a Farm and Water Collector to keep your bees fed.

rewards.title: Honey Vault
rewards.history_empty: No claims yet — your first claim will appear here.

leaderboard.title: Royal Leaderboard
leaderboard.no_data: No colonies on the board yet. Be the first.

mint.title: Forge Royal Regalia
mint.intro: Mint a unique cNFT skin onto your buildings. Skins boost production and stay in your wallet forever.
mint.no_eligible: No buildings are at skin-unlock level yet. Upgrade a building to L3+ to forge regalia.

profile.title: Profile
profile.language_subtitle: App language. Auto-detected from device on first launch.
profile.ml_disclaimer: Translations marked (machine) are auto-translated and may have small errors. We refine them over time.
profile.reset_confirm_body: This wipes your local progress. Your wallet stays connected. Cloud save will be overwritten on next sync.

buildings.water_collector_desc: Pulls fresh water from the air.

build_picker.title: Build new
build_picker.subtitle: Choose a building to place in this slot.
build_picker.demolish_confirm_body: Resources spent will not be refunded. This cannot be undone.

toast.storage_warn: 🍯 Vault almost full — claim before you lose income.
toast.starvation_warn: ⚠️ Hives starving — energy or water is too low.

onboarding.page1_body: Your queen has chosen you to rebuild her hive. Place buildings on a 3×3 grid; they produce honey even when you sleep.
onboarding.page2_body: Resources accumulate up to 48 hours. Long-press any cell to preview production. Tap any cell to build or upgrade.
onboarding.page3_body: Climb the Royal Leaderboard, complete daily quests, and forge cNFT skins for your hives that live in your wallet.

tutorial.first_build_hint: Tap this glowing tile to place your first Bee Hive.
tutorial.first_build_done: Your first hive is humming. Welcome to the apiary.

quests.long_press_preview: Long-press a tile to preview production

streak.label: 🔥 {{days}}-day streak
streak.title: Login streak
streak.broken: Streak ended yesterday — start fresh today.

urgency.bloom_event_body: All production ×{{mult}} for {{hours}}h. Build now while it lasts.

bloom.active_body: All hives produce {{mult}}× while the bloom lasts.

first_build.1: An empty grove. Tap a tile and let us begin again.
first_build.2: Choose a hex, sovereign. Even one bloom is a start.
first_build.3: The combs are silent. Place the first hive — I beg you.
first_build.4: Without a single hive, there is no kingdom. Only memory.

bloom_active.1: The Bloom is upon us — every comb sings ×{{mult}} louder.
bloom_active.2: Pollen everywhere. The hives drink it all.
bloom_active.3: While the Bloom holds, every hour is generous.
bloom_active.4: I have not felt a season this rich in a long time.
bloom_active.5: Tend now, sovereign — the air itself is sweet.

near_bloom.1: I smell the first flowers. The Bloom comes within hours.
near_bloom.2: Soon the petals open. Be ready to gather.
near_bloom.3: The wind shifts — Spring Bloom approaches.
near_bloom.4: Prepare the combs. The Bloom is near.

claim_ready.1: The vaults are heavy with honey. Will you collect?
claim_ready.2: Hours of pollen await your hand, sovereign.
claim_ready.3: The hives have done their work. Yours awaits.
claim_ready.4: A claim is ready. Do not let it ferment.
claim_ready.5: The combs are full. Empty them and grow.

low_water.1: Our combs run dry. Build a Spring or all is lost.
low_water.2: Water — without it, no royal jelly. None.
low_water.3: The bees thirst, sovereign. Find them water.
low_water.4: I would trade gold for a stream right now.

low_food.1: The grove is bare. The bees grow weak.
low_food.2: Without forage, even a queen falters. Plant something.
low_food.3: Empty bellies, empty hives. Build a Glade.

low_energy.1: The sun is generous, but we have no panels to catch it.
low_energy.2: Solar warmth is wasted. Place a Solar Panel.
low_energy.3: Energy bleeds away unstored. Build me a panel.
low_energy.4: Without warmth, the wax cools. Energy, please.

low_honey.1: Our honey reserves are shamefully thin.
low_honey.2: A hive without honey is a hive without name.
low_honey.3: Build hives, sovereign. We must have honey.
low_honey.4: Honey runs low. Tend more. Tend faster.

near_full.1: The vaults near full — we lose what we cannot store.
near_full.2: Storage spills, sovereign. Claim, or build me a granary.
near_full.3: Every drop above the brim is wasted. Act soon.
near_full.4: Full combs, lost yield. Claim now.

idle.1: All is quiet. The bees hum, the work continues.
idle.2: A patient kingdom is a wise one, sovereign.
idle.3: I watch the combs fill, slow as honey, sweet as time.
idle.4: Tend a hex, if you wish. Or simply rest with us.
idle.5: Time itself is our crop. We harvest patience.
idle.7: Bees know what to do. We need only believe.
idle.8: Even idle, the colony grows. That is the gift of bees.
